name: Create an Access group
description: Create an Access group Creates a new Access group. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups
Creates a new Access group.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an Access group
description: Delete an Access group Deletes an Access group. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups/{group_id}

name: Get an Access group
description: Get an Access group Fetches a single Access group. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups/{group_id}

name: List Access groups
description: List Access groups Lists all Access groups. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups
Lists all Access groups.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); search (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update an Access group
description: Update an Access group Updates a configured Access group. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/groups/{group_id}
